one_line: Yadava ruler who pushed his frontier towards the Malaprabha–Krishna line against the Hoysalas.

appearance.age_look: early 40s, medium height, wiry but strong build
appearance.face: oval face, wheatish Deccan complexion, sharp nose, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard along the jawline; intense, calculating eyes with a slight furrowed brow, default expression focused and resolute
appearance.hair: straight black hair pulled back into a short, tidy knot at the back of the head; front hair smoothed back from the forehead; wears a plain gold circlet-band with a small central oval gem resting low on the forehead
appearance.costume: era-accurate 12th–13th century Deccan royal-war attire: a knee-length off-white cotton tunic (angarkha-style) with side tie and narrow brown piping, over which he wears a fitted sleeveless quilted leather jerkin in deep brown; lower body in a tightly wrapped maroon cotton dhoti, pleated in the front and reaching to the ankles, worn over simple brown leather shoes; a long mustard-yellow cotton sash (uttariya) draped from left shoulder across torso and around the waist, its ends tucked at the right hip; forearms protected by simple bronze bracers; minimal but royal jewellery—short gold necklace with a small circular pendant, a pair of small gold stud earrings, and a single broad gold ring on his right hand; overall look practical for campaign yet clearly kingly
appearance.signature: a straight-edged Deccan sword with a slightly broad leaf-shaped blade, iron with a simple steel sheen, carried in a plain brown leather scabbard; the hilt has a subtle disc-shaped pommel and an unadorned cross-guard, wrapped in dark cloth for grip, usually held in his right hand or resting at his left hip

ref_desc: Bhillama V has an oval wheatish face with moustache and short beard, black hair in a knot with a gold circlet, off-white tunic, maroon dhoti, brown leather jerkin and bracers, mustard sash, subtle gold jewellery, and a plain-hilted Deccan sword in brown scabbard, in off-white, maroon, deep brown, mustard and gold tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Bhillama V: a wiry, serious Yadava king in his early forties with an oval wheatish face, sharp nose, intense eyes, neat moustache and short beard along the jawline. His straight black hair is pulled into a short knot at the back, front hair smoothed back, and he wears a simple gold circlet with a small central oval gem resting low on his forehead. Show him in era-accurate Deccan royal-war dress: a knee-length off-white cotton tunic with narrow brown edging, a fitted sleeveless deep-brown quilted leather jerkin over it, and a maroon cotton dhoti tightly wrapped and pleated to the ankles. Add simple brown leather shoes and a long mustard-yellow cotton sash draped from his left shoulder across his torso and around his waist, with ends tucked at the right hip. Forearms have plain bronze bracers; jewellery is restrained—a short gold necklace with round pendant, small gold stud earrings, and one broad gold ring on his right hand. His signature weapon is a straight-edged Deccan sword with a slightly broad leaf-shaped blade and a plain dark-wrapped hilt with disc pommel and simple cross-guard, in a brown leather scabbard at his left hip or in his right hand. Use a palette dominated by off-white, maroon, deep brown, mustard yellow, and gold, and present him in a neutral stance, front and three-quarter views, clearly showing face, hair, clothing details, and sword.
